name: livenova
description: Modern live streaming platform — exceeds X77Live with WebRTC, real-time chat, gifts, and multi-language support

scripts.dev: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run dev -w apps/worker
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/server"
scripts.dev:cf: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run dev -w apps/worker
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.deploy:cf: npm run build:cf && npm run deploy -w apps/worker
